purpose: City-specific discovery of official cadastral parcel services for Mulia, Puncak Jaya, Central Papua, Indonesia; source and coverage claims are limited to observed evidence.
name: Mulia

queries.query: Mulia Papua Indonesia official cadastral parcel map ATR BPN BHUMI Puncak Jaya
queries.result: Found the official ATR/BPN BHUMI interactive land-information map and ATLAS geospatial catalog, plus official/legal evidence identifying Kantor Pertanahan Kabupaten Puncak Jaya. No indexed Mulia parcel layer or downloadable parcel response was found.

queries.query: Mulia Papua Tengah peta bidang tanah resmi ATR BPN Puncak Jaya
queries.result: Found the Indonesian-language BHUMI/ATLAS official services and evidence for Kantor Pertanahan Kabupaten Puncak Jaya as the relevant land office. Search results did not expose a public Mulia parcel dataset or safe parcel feature response.

officialSources.observation: Official BHUMI ATR/BPN map application. The landing page describes an open geospatial land-information map, embeds the current public map console at https://konsolbhumi.atrbpn.go.id, and states that displayed information is not guaranteed complete or current.
officialSources.custodian: Ministry of Agrarian Affairs and Spatial Planning / National Land Agency (ATR/BPN)

officialSources.observation: Official ATR/BPN ATLAS catalog. Its current anonymous catalog response contained seven public datasets, none identified as cadastral parcels for Mulia or Puncak Jaya; the listed public datasets were offices, disaster, health-access, islands, and related non-parcel layers.

Official-regulation mirror of ATR/BPN organizational appendix listing Kantor Pertanahan Kabupaten Puncak Jaya (office series 26-14). This evidences the local/district land-office custodian, not an open parcel geometry feed.
officialSources.custodian: Kantor Pertanahan Kabupaten Puncak Jaya / ATR-BPN

officialSources.observation: Official Puncak Jaya PPID portal was checked for local administrative evidence; it showed a land-database/digital certificate inventory entry but no public parcel geometry service for Mulia.
officialSources.custodian: Pemerintah Kabupaten Puncak Jaya (administrative context only)

requests.outcome: Loaded; embedded public console URL identified. No parcel data was returned by the landing document.

requests.method: GET current public map-console HTML and JavaScript bundles
requests.outcome: Console assets loaded. The inspected anonymous bundle exposed Sentuh Tanahku/login-oriented routes; no safe anonymous parcel feature endpoint or public Mulia parcel layer was identified. No login, credentials, or CAPTCHA interaction was attempted.

Confirmed BHUMI is an interactive spatial map and documents parcel/land layers and coordinate display, but the documentation page returned no Mulia feature data, native parcel schema, or CRS for a parcel response.
Confirmed public catalog/import concepts and supported spatial formats; no Mulia parcel dataset or public download was returned.
Returned total=7 public datasets. None was a Mulia/Puncak Jaya cadastral parcel layer; no parcel geometry, feature ID, field schema, or CRS was returned.
Returned ATLAS branding/configuration only; no parcel service endpoint or layer configuration.

requests.method: GET WMS capabilities probe using host named in the public ATLAS catalog
requests.outcome: DNS resolution failed from the research environment. This is an infrastructure/access failure, not evidence of absent coverage; no retry with TLS bypass or credentials was made.

requests.outcome: DNS resolution failed from the research environment. No feature request was sent and no geometry was obtained.

registryBasis: A current official ATR/BPN public map/catalog was verified, and official organizational evidence identifies Kantor Pertanahan Kabupaten Puncak Jaya as the district land-office custodian. No local municipal parcel API or anonymous Mulia parcel geometry response was established.

nativeSchema.compositeKeyProvenance: No parcel feature response was returned; no native identity was inferred from city, district, office, or catalog metadata.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Indonesia-wide ATR/BPN land-information and geospatial catalog services, with district land-office responsibility for Puncak Jaya.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Public BHUMI/ATLAS documentation and seven anonymous ATLAS catalog records; no open Mulia/Puncak Jaya parcel feature layer or geometry response.

remainingUncertainty: The exact WUP point was preserved and not shifted. BHUMI may expose additional parcel information through map interactions, restricted layers, or a service unavailable from this environment, but no anonymous safe ID-plus-geometry response was observed. Catalog absence, DNS failure, or an unusable/login-oriented UI is not treated as citywide absence. This packet is research evidence only and does not constitute source integration or admission.
